hero.lead: A continuous experience for transforming files, documents, images, audio and your professional presence, without jumping between platforms.
hero.dynamicSuite: One suite. Less friction. More output.

suite.lead: Every product has its own presence, imagery and message. The spotlight shifts automatically to reveal each part of the suite.

branding.lead: No product in the suite feels like a clone of another. Color, tone and imagery are considered one by one: that's what you see here.

audience.lead: Students, professionals and technicians use the suite for the same reasons: less friction, more focus on what matters.

productivity.title: Productivity
productivity.copy: Less time switching apps, more time delivering. Every Studio solves one task completely, without detours.

school.title: School & Studies
school.copy: From assignments to resumes and presentations: tools simple enough for the very first day of class.

projects.title: Projects
projects.copy: Documents, files and resources for a project, handled from start to finish within the same suite.

career.title: Career Growth
career.copy: Resumes, proposals and presentations with the polish of someone who's already made it, without hiring a designer.

organization.title: Organization
organization.copy: One login, one history, one place. Your digital routine stops being scattered across ten browser tabs.

workflow.lead: Every tool gets its moment in the spotlight, with its own identity, message and imagery: real desktop screenshots, never generic mockups.
workflow.feature1Copy: Each product shows up with its own brand, with no extra effort on your part.
workflow.feature2Copy: One visual identity across the entire suite.

onboarding.lead: From account to first finished file, with no installs and no waiting on anyone.
onboarding.step1Copy: A simple sign-up with email or Google. One account works across the entire suite, not just a single Studio.
onboarding.step2Copy: Start free right away, or pick a paid frequency (monthly, quarterly, annual) whenever you need more.
onboarding.step3Copy: The same session unlocks any tool in the suite, the moment you need it.

trust.lead: Every session is verified, every processed file has an owner, and information about how everything works is always within reach.
trust.item1Copy: Account-level authentication, with full control over where and how your session stays active.
trust.item2Copy: Every file and every download belongs to the account that created it, never shared between users.
trust.item3Copy: Terms, cookie policy, copyright and security documentation are always one click away.

pricing.lead: Student, freelancer or IT professional: pick a frequency (monthly, quarterly or annual) and get to work in minutes, in the same session you already use across the suite.
pricing.featureLogin: One login across the entire suite
pricing.note: A single plan grows with your team: the more the suite is used, the more efficient the cost per person becomes.

proof.quote: One single suite, with several entry points and an experience that never stands still.

footer.tagline: Digital tools for work that keeps moving forward.

convertall.verb: Converts, merges, extracts, resizes and exports files.
convertall.tagline: One place for dozens of file formats, nothing to install.

backcut.verb: Removes backgrounds and isolates objects in images.
backcut.tagline: Precision cutouts, ready in seconds, right in the browser.

compresshub.verb: Compresses and optimizes files, shrinking their size.
compresshub.tagline: Fewer megabytes, no visible loss in quality.

docforge.verb: Creates professional documents such as receipts, invoices, contracts and proposals.
docforge.tagline: Business documents formatted like they came out of a design studio.

editpdf.verb: Edits, organizes, annotates, signs and exports PDFs.
editpdf.tagline: PDFs stop being a dead end: edit them like any other document.

qrforge.verb: Creates QR codes for URLs, text, contacts and Wi-Fi.
qrforge.tagline: QR codes with their own identity, ready to print or share.

reccast.verb: Records, reviews, organizes and shares audio.
reccast.tagline: A pocket audio studio, for anyone recording ideas every day.

resumeforge.verb: Creates and edits professional resumes with templates.

plansNotice.title: Notice on subscriptions and plans
plansNotice.p1: PixGo does not charge for subscriptions to content or for the content itself. The price of paid plans corresponds exclusively to the use of the platform as a software service (SaaS) and player.
plansNotice.p2: The amounts paid are used to cover technology infrastructure costs and the operation of the platform's artificial intelligence (AI) engine, which is used to detect copyright-protected works and to moderate content.
plansNotice.p3: Subscribing to a plan does not constitute the purchase, licence or transfer of any content, nor does it guarantee the permanent availability of any particular content, channel or feature, in accordance with the Terms of Service.
